# Cheetah

> Differentiable particle accelerator optics simulation in PyTorch. Cheetah tracks macroparticles with ParticleBeam and distribution moments with ParameterBeam through beamlines built from Elements and Segments.

Use electronvolts for reference energy and metres for positions. Use Segment.summary() and Beam.summary() to inspect simulations.

## Getting started

- [Quickstart](https://cheetah-accelerator.readthedocs.io/en/latest/getting_started/simple.html): Build a lattice and track a beam.
- [Beam representations](https://cheetah-accelerator.readthedocs.io/en/latest/getting_started/beam_representations.html): Choose between ParticleBeam and ParameterBeam.
- [Coordinate system](https://cheetah-accelerator.readthedocs.io/en/latest/getting_started/coordinate_system.html): Coordinate conventions, units, and particle species.
- [Gradient-based optimisation](https://cheetah-accelerator.readthedocs.io/en/latest/getting_started/gradientbased.html): Tune beamline settings with PyTorch autograd.
- [AI assistants](https://cheetah-accelerator.readthedocs.io/en/latest/getting_started/ai_assistants.html): Summary APIs, agent skill installation, and MCP setup.

## Reference

- [Accelerator API](https://cheetah-accelerator.readthedocs.io/en/latest/accelerator.html): Segments and accelerator elements.
- [Particle API](https://cheetah-accelerator.readthedocs.io/en/latest/particles.html): Beams and species.
- [LatticeJSON](https://cheetah-accelerator.readthedocs.io/en/latest/latticejson.html): Load and save lattice models.
- [Custom elements](https://cheetah-accelerator.readthedocs.io/en/latest/getting_started/custom_elements.html): Implement and test an element.

## Optional

- [Repository](https://github.com/desy-ml/cheetah): Source code, tests, and contributor guidance.
- [Agent skill](https://github.com/desy-ml/cheetah/tree/master/skills/cheetah): Tracking and matching workflow for agents.
- [Cheetah paper](https://doi.org/10.1103/PhysRevAccelBeams.27.054601): Simulation methods and benchmarks.
